transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been dealing with constant, uncontrollable worry about almost every area of my life, including my work, family, and finances. This has been going on nearly every day for about 10 months now. I just can't seem to turn my mind off, and it's becoming too much to handle.
Along with this worry, have you also been feeling persistently down, or have you lost interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy doing?

No, I wouldn't say I'm feeling down or losing interest in the things I enjoy. My main issue is really just the constant, exhausting worry that keeps my mind running all the time. It's the anxiety itself that is draining me, rather than feeling depressed.
